message: ドロ談合

name: Sally
message: 「Look-left, look-right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan?」
As I was walking down a path under the clear autumn sky, Sally-chan suddenly popped out from the bushes.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, what are you doing in a place like--」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp! It's noooothing!」

name: Sally
message: 「See ya! Bye-byeee!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's blatantly suspicious, right? Tail her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on. I'm telling you, prying isn't nice.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sneak, sneak...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyoeeeeh!? P-P-P-P-Prez, were you following me!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh-la-la, that's Sally-chan for ya♪ The idol of the Demon World, captivating even the student council\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... We just happened to be passing by.」

name: Sally
message: 「Bleeeh! Even if you say that, I'm nooot telling you the secret of my dorodango!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch! I thought you were hiding something big, and it's just that?」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp!? Awawawa, is this that 'leading-question' thing? That's mean, so mean!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You just blew your own cover.」
Looking closely behind Sally-chan, several dorodango were hidden in the shadow of the courtyard wall.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, these are really well made. Are you letting them dry right now?」

name: Sally
message: 「Heyy! Don't steal them!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, I won't touch them, I promise. Still, Sally-chan, that makes me sound pretty bad, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「I bet someone like Paqy is totally the type to sneak over during recess and smash dorodango!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't paint me as some petty, vindictive jerk!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wouldn't even want a pathetic thing with cracks all over its surface like this if you gave it to me for free.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right, there are cracks running all over it...」

name: Sally
message: 「Jeez! That's why I was keeping it a secret!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, Prez. How am I s'posed to make the surface of a dorodango hard?!」

name: Sally
message: 「When I mixed dirt from all sorts of places, I got the core in the middle rock-hard.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even just doing that is amazing.」
Trial and error in dorodango-making is a path everyone walks.
I used to gather dirt from all over Ryuusei Town and try various blends myself, though I could never quite make one I was satisfied with.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe Paqy knows?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen here, Master Synn. Just 'cause I'm a Great Sage don't mean I know everythin', ya hear?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena, making her entrance from the secret passage\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah?!」
Ms. Helena emerged from inside the fountain and walked over to us.

name: Sally
message: 「It's the Chairwoman!」

name: Helena
message: 「Alright. Let's get straight to the main topic, shall we?」

name: Helena
message: 「Long ago... in my childhood, I was a woman who earned the moniker of Dorodango Master...」

name: Helena
message: 「If you use the fine, dry sand at the base of Finis Tower, the surface will take on a sheen and increase in hardness, you know.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! Now that's some good intel. Thanks a bunch♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Sharing information is a matter of give-and-take... Pray tell me your technique for hardening the center of a dorodango.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir! If you mix dirt from by the church, behind the girls' dorm, and Prez's family field, it gets solid as a rock!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, with this, I can finally make the perfect dorodango. Let me join in too♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh! Go right ahead and use all the dirt and sand I gathered without holdin' back!」

name: Helena
message: 「Knead, knead, knead...」

name: Sally
message: 「Mix, mix, mix...」
Sally and Ms. Helena team up to take on the challenge of making the perfect dorodango.
The way the two of them make it is different from what I'm familiar with. It seems the ratios and process vary subtly depending on when and where you grew up.
I want to join in too, but... for a little while now, students have been glancing over in our direction.

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmm? Aren't you gonna make a mud ball too, Prez?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'd love to join in, I really would, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「As Student Council President and a member of the Crusaders, I think I ought to carry myself with a bit more dignity.」

name: Sally
message: 「But the Chairwoman's doing it too, ya know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Are you saying I lack dignity...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-th-th-that's not what I meant at all!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally, let me join in too!」
For the first time in about ten years, I make a mud ball.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Helena, won't those clothes get completely dirty?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? Isn't that the very reason you're here, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. If you hand-rub them with lemon juice or shampoo before washing, the stains will come right out.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahooo! Nailed it♪」
